name: 26155 · N Martinsvlle, WV
findings: ZIP 26155 (N Martinsvlle) has 41 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 26155 (N Martinsvlle) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
